topics.name: cmd_vel
topics.description: What the robot is being told to drive (the Gamepad's cmd_vel). The eyes look into a turn, up going forward and down in reverse; no driving for a while and they get sleepy.

topics.name: buttons
topics.description: Gamepad buttons, each flashing an expression: a happy, b surprised, x sad, y angry.

topics.name: set_expression
topics.description: A standing expression (neutral, happy, sad, angry, surprised, sleepy, off) that overrides the automatic one. An empty string hands it back.

display_id.label: Display
display_id.description: The screen on the robot (its placement) that shows the face. On the robot its adapter draws it; in Studio the simulator does.

idle_after_s.label: Sleepy After
idle_after_s.description: Seconds without driving before the face gets sleepy. 0 keeps it awake.

flash_s.label: Button Expression For
flash_s.description: How long a button's expression shows.

look_gain.label: Look Into Turns
look_gain.description: How far the eyes follow a turn, 0 (not at all) to 1.

rate_hz.label: Update Rate
rate_hz.description: How often the face is re-evaluated (for going sleepy, and ending a button's expression).
